name: [bkms] 打包并推送 Helm Chart
description: [请勿删除或修改] 蓝鲸服务治理（bkms）创建的流水线，支持基于 Git 代码库打包并推送 Helm Chart 到 BkRepo Helm 仓库

params.desc: 分支名称（如 master） 或 Tag 名称（如 v1.0.0）或 CommitID（32位随机字符串）
params.name: 代码库版本号

params.desc: bkms 内置 HelmRepo 地址，格式如：http://helm.bkrepo.example.com/api/${projectCode}/helm/charts
params.name: Helm Repo 地址

params.desc: 构建出的 Helm Chart 名称，一般为 bkms 的 App 名称
params.name: Helm Chart 名称

params.desc: 输出的 Chart 版本（version & appVersion）
params.name: 输出 Chart 版本

params.desc: 指定该目录进行 HelmChart 打包并推送
params.name: 构建执行目录

params.desc: Helm、Helmify、Kustomize 等二进制下载基础 URL，需要拼接具体的二进制名称使用
params.name: 二进制工具下载基础 URL

elements.name: 构建并推送 Helm Chart
elements.script:
set -euo pipefail

# ============================================================
# Environment Variables (provided externally)
# ============================================================
# BKMS_HELM_REPO_URL          - Helm Repo URL
# BKMS_HELM_CHART_NAME        - Helm Chart name
# BKMS_HELM_CHART_VERSION     - Output Chart version (version & appVersion)
# BKMS_HELM_CHART_BUILD_DIR   - Build directory for Helm Chart
# BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL    - Base URL for helm utils (helm/helmify/kustomize binaries)

# ============================================================
# 0. Validate required environment variables
# ============================================================
for var in BKMS_HELM_REPO_URL \
        BKMS_HELM_CHART_NAME \
        BKMS_HELM_CHART_VERSION \
        BKMS_HELM_CHART_BUILD_DIR \
        BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL; do
    if [ -z "${!var:-}" ]; then
        echo "[ERROR] Environment variable '${var}' is not set or empty. Please check and try again."
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo "=========================================="
echo " BKMS Helm Chart Build & Push Script"
echo "=========================================="
echo " Repo:           ${BKMS_HELM_REPO_URL}"
echo " Chart:          ${BKMS_HELM_CHART_NAME}"
echo " Version:        ${BKMS_HELM_CHART_VERSION}"
echo " BuildDir:       ${BKMS_HELM_CHART_BUILD_DIR}"
echo " HelmURL:        ${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/helm"
echo " HelmifyURL:     ${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/helmify"
echo " KustomizeURL:   ${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/kustomize"
echo "=========================================="

# ============================================================
# 1. Download helm & helmify binaries
# ============================================================
TOOLS_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
export PATH="${TOOLS_DIR}:${PATH}"

echo ""
echo ">>> [Step 1] Downloading helm and helmify ..."

echo "    Downloading helm from ${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/helm ..."
curl -sSL "${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/helm" -o "${TOOLS_DIR}/helm"
chmod +x "${TOOLS_DIR}/helm"
echo "    helm installed: $(helm version --short 2>/dev/null || true)"

echo "    Downloading helmify from ${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/helmify ..."
curl -sSL "${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/helmify" -o "${TOOLS_DIR}/helmify"
chmod +x "${TOOLS_DIR}/helmify"
echo "    helmify installed: $(helmify --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'ok')"

# kustomize
echo "    Downloading kustomize from ${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/kustomize ..."
curl -sSL "${BKMS_HELM_TOOLCHAIN_BASE_URL}/kustomize" -o "${TOOLS_DIR}/kustomize"
chmod +x "${TOOLS_DIR}/kustomize"
echo "    kustomize installed: $(kustomize version --short 2>/dev/null || true)"

# ============================================================
# 2. Validate build directory; convert with helmify if needed
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo ">>> [Step 2] Checking if ${BKMS_HELM_CHART_BUILD_DIR} is a valid Helm Chart ..."

CHART_DIR="${BKMS_HELM_CHART_BUILD_DIR}"
# Strip leading whitespace and / to prevent path traversal
CHART_DIR="${CHART_DIR#"${CHART_DIR%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
CHART_DIR="${CHART_DIR#/}"
CHART_SOURCE="native"

is_valid_helm_chart() {
    local dir="$1"
    if [ -f "${dir}/Chart.yaml" ] || [ -f "${dir}/Chart.yml" ]; then
        if helm lint "${dir}" --quiet 2>/dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi

        echo "    [ERROR] Chart.yaml/Chart.yml exists but is not a valid Helm Chart. Aborting."
        echo "    [INFO] helm lint output:"
        helm lint "${dir}" || true
        exit 1
    fi
    return 1
}

if is_valid_helm_chart "${CHART_DIR}"; then
    echo "    [OK] Directory is already a valid Helm Chart."
else
    # ---- Try kustomize first ----
    KUSTOMIZATION_FILE=""
    if [ -f "${CHART_DIR}/kustomization.yaml" ] || [ -f "${CHART_DIR}/kustomization.yml" ]; then
        KUSTOMIZATION_FILE="${CHART_DIR}"
    fi

    if [ -n "${KUSTOMIZATION_FILE}" ]; then
        echo "    [INFO] Detected kustomization at ${KUSTOMIZATION_FILE}, running kustomize build ..."
        KUSTOMIZE_OUTPUT_DIR="${CHART_DIR}/_kustomize_output"
        mkdir -p "${KUSTOMIZE_OUTPUT_DIR}"

        if ! kustomize build "${KUSTOMIZATION_FILE}" > "${KUSTOMIZE_OUTPUT_DIR}/all.yaml" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "    [ERROR] kustomize build failed. Aborting."
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "    [OK] kustomize build succeeded."

        HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR="${KUSTOMIZE_OUTPUT_DIR}/${BKMS_HELM_CHART_NAME}"
        mkdir -p "${HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR}"

        cat "${KUSTOMIZE_OUTPUT_DIR}/all.yaml" | helmify "${HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR}"

        if is_valid_helm_chart "${HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR}"; then
            echo "    [OK] kustomize -> helmify conversion succeeded."
            CHART_DIR="${HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR}"
            CHART_SOURCE="kustomize_helmify"
        else
            echo "    [ERROR] kustomize -> helmify conversion did not produce a valid Helm Chart. Aborting."
            exit 1
        fi
    else
        # ---- Fallback: plain helmify ----
        echo "    [WARN] Directory is NOT a valid Helm Chart. Attempting helmify conversion ..."

        HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR="${CHART_DIR}/_helmify_output/${BKMS_HELM_CHART_NAME}"
        mkdir -p "${HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR}"

        find "${CHART_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' \) \
            -exec cat {} + | helmify "${HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR}"

        if is_valid_helm_chart "${HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR}"; then
            echo "    [OK] helmify conversion succeeded."
            CHART_DIR="${HELMIFY_OUTPUT_DIR}"
            CHART_SOURCE="helmify"
        else
            echo "    [ERROR] helmify conversion failed. Result is still not a valid Helm Chart."
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
fi

# ============================================================
# 2.5 Fix helmify line-wrap: merge folded Helm template expressions
#     helmify uses Go's yaml.v3 which wraps lines at 80 chars,
#     producing output like:
#       key: {{ .Values.xxx | toYaml
#         | indent 1 }}
#     This perl one-liner folds the continuation back into a single line:
#       key: {{ .Values.xxx | toYaml | indent 1 }}
# ============================================================
if [ "${CHART_SOURCE}" = "helmify" ] || [ "${CHART_SOURCE}" = "kustomize_helmify" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo ">>> [Step 2.5] Fixing helmify line-wrap in template files ..."

    find "${CHART_DIR}/templates" -type f \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' \) 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
        # Only merge continuation lines that belong to an unclosed {{ ... }} expression.
        # The regex matches: a line containing {{ without a closing }}, followed by
        # a newline + indentation. It folds them into one line, then loops (redo)
        # until no more unclosed expressions span multiple lines.
        if ! perl -i -0pe 's/((?:^|(?<=\n))[^\n]*\{\{(?:(?!\}\}).)*)\n[ \t]+/\1 /gm; redo if /\{\{(?:(?!\}\}).)*\n/' "$f"; then
            echo "    [ERROR] Failed to fix helmify line-wrap in template file: ${f}"
            exit 1
        fi
    done

    echo "    [OK] Template line-wrap fix applied."
fi

# ============================================================
# 3. Replace Chart version (version & appVersion)
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo ">>> [Step 3] Setting Chart version to ${BKMS_HELM_CHART_VERSION} ..."

CHART_YAML="${CHART_DIR}/Chart.yaml"
if [ ! -f "${CHART_YAML}" ]; then
    CHART_YAML="${CHART_DIR}/Chart.yml"
fi

if [ ! -f "${CHART_YAML}" ]; then
    echo "    [ERROR] Chart.yaml not found. Aborting."
    exit 1
fi

sed -i "s/^name:.*/name: ${BKMS_HELM_CHART_NAME}/" "${CHART_YAML}"
sed -i "s/^version:.*/version: ${BKMS_HELM_CHART_VERSION}/" "${CHART_YAML}"

if grep -q "^appVersion:" "${CHART_YAML}"; then
    sed -i "s/^appVersion:.*/appVersion: \"v${BKMS_HELM_CHART_VERSION}\"/" "${CHART_YAML}"
else
    echo "appVersion: \"v${BKMS_HELM_CHART_VERSION}\"" >> "${CHART_YAML}"
fi

echo "    [OK] Chart.yaml updated:"
grep -E "^(name|version|appVersion):" "${CHART_YAML}" | sed 's/^/       /'

# ============================================================
# 4. Package the Chart
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo ">>> [Step 4] Packaging Helm Chart ..."

PACKAGE_OUTPUT_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
helm package "${CHART_DIR}" --destination "${PACKAGE_OUTPUT_DIR}"

CHART_PACKAGE=$(find "${PACKAGE_OUTPUT_DIR}" -name '*.tgz' | head -n 1)

if [ -z "${CHART_PACKAGE}" ]; then
    echo "    [ERROR] Packaging failed. No .tgz file found."
    exit 1
fi

echo "    [OK] Package created: ${CHART_PACKAGE}"

# ============================================================
# 5. Push Chart to Helm Repo
# ============================================================
echo ""
echo ">>> [Step 5] Pushing Chart to ${BKMS_HELM_REPO_URL} ..."

CRED_USER="${{settings.bkms_helm_repo_credential.username}}"
CRED_PWD="${{settings.bkms_helm_repo_credential.password}}"

HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/helm_push_response.txt -w "%{http_code}" \
    -F "chart=@${CHART_PACKAGE}" \
    -u "$CRED_USER:$CRED_PWD" \
    "${BKMS_HELM_REPO_URL}")

RESPONSE_BODY=$(cat /tmp/helm_push_response.txt 2>/dev/null || true)

if [ "${HTTP_CODE}" -ge 200 ] && [ "${HTTP_CODE}" -lt 300 ]; then
    echo "    [OK] Push succeeded! (HTTP ${HTTP_CODE})"
    echo "    Response: ${RESPONSE_BODY}"
else
    echo "    [ERROR] Push failed! (HTTP ${HTTP_CODE})"
    echo "    Response: ${RESPONSE_BODY}"
    exit 1
fi

# ============================================================
# Cleanup
# ============================================================
rm -rf "${TOOLS_DIR}" "${PACKAGE_OUTPUT_DIR}" /tmp/helm_push_response.txt

echo ""
echo "[DONE] Chart ${BKMS_HELM_CHART_NAME}:${BKMS_HELM_CHART_VERSION} has been pushed to ${BKMS_HELM_REPO_URL}"

stages.name: 代码拉取 & 构建 & 推送
